security_audit.summary: The installation instructions contain a critical remote-code execution chain that disables TLS verification and runs remotely supplied content. The reset and migration procedures also recursively delete the embedded database, while Markdown formatting and loopback checks were false positives.

remediation.issue: Remote content is downloaded with TLS verification disabled and executed by Node.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the command. Distribute a versioned, integrity-verified installer or instruct users to run only audited repository scripts after review.

remediation.issue: Reset and migration guidance uses recursive deletion of the database directory.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit backup and confirmation step, validate the resolved instance path, and provide a dedicated reset command with safeguards.

remediation.issue: Port troubleshooting terminates every process on port 3100.
remediation.suggestion: Show matching processes first and require users to select or confirm the Paperclip process before stopping it.

content.value_statement: Accepted plans often fail when ownership and dependencies remain unclear. This skill turns them into verified Paperclip issues with deliberate assignees, statuses, and blockers.
actual_capabilities: Break an accepted plan into concrete deliverable issues.
Match each issue to an agent specialty instead of assigning by default.
Identify independent work that can start in parallel.
Create a compact task matrix with owners, statuses, and blockers.
Verify the issue graph before closing the source planning issue.
limitations: It does not provide Paperclip API instructions or create issues by itself.
It does not prescribe a plan format.
It requires an accepted plan and knowledge of available agent specialties.
It cannot resolve missing hires, tools, decisions, or external inputs.

use_cases.title: Prepare an engineering rollout
use_cases.description: Split an approved technical rollout into owned implementation, testing, and release tasks with explicit blockers.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a cross-functional campaign
use_cases.description: Translate a marketing plan into parallel design, research, content, and approval tasks.

use_cases.title: Review a task graph
use_cases.description: Check whether a planned issue graph has correct owners, start conditions, and dependency links.

prompt_templates.title: Create basic tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this accepted plan into Paperclip tasks. List an owner, initial status, and blockers for each task.

prompt_templates.title: Assign by specialty
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this plan and these agent specialties. Create a task matrix that assigns each deliverable to the best-suited agent.

prompt_templates.title: Model dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this accepted plan into a dependency-aware Paperclip task graph. Use blockedByIssueIds for every hard prerequisite and explain which tasks can start now.

prompt_templates.title: Validate before closure
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these created Paperclip issues against the source plan. Identify missing deliverables, incorrect blockers, unclear start conditions, and assignment gaps before closing the planning issue.

output_examples.input: A plan needs research, a landing page, legal review, and launch.
output: Research: assigned to the research specialist; can start now.
Landing page: assigned to the design specialist; blocked by research findings.
Legal review: assigned to the legal specialist; blocked by final landing page copy.
Launch: assigned to the operations specialist; blocked by legal approval.

output_examples.input: A plan has two independent deliverables and one final integration step.
output: Two tasks are marked ready because they have no prerequisites.
The integration task is blocked by both deliverable issue IDs.
The task matrix records owners, statuses, blockers, and start reasons.

best_practices: Record every hard dependency with blockedByIssueIds, not only in prose.
Confirm agent specialties before assigning work.
Re-fetch and verify created issues before closing the planning issue.
anti_patterns: Using parent-child nesting as an execution blocker.
Assigning tasks to the planner when a better specialist exists.
Closing the planning issue before checking the created dependency graph.

faq.question: Does this skill create a plan?
faq.answer: No. It converts an accepted plan into executable Paperclip tasks.

faq.question: Does it require a fixed plan format?
faq.answer: No. It supports prose, outlines, tables, RACI documents, and other formats.

faq.question: How are task dependencies represented?
faq.answer: Use blockedByIssueIds on each dependent task for every hard prerequisite.

faq.question: Can one agent receive parallel work?
faq.answer: Yes. Independent branches can run concurrently when the agent supports concurrent runs.

faq.question: What should happen when no specialist fits?
faq.answer: Surface the gap as a hire, tool, external dependency, or board decision.

faq.question: Should parent-child issues block execution?
faq.answer: No. Use parent-child relationships for structure and blockedByIssueIds for execution blocking.
